name: computer_observe
description: Capture the current screen of the session's runtime and return it as a PNG image. Call this before any coordinate-based action: x/y for click, move and scroll are pixels in the image this returns, origin at the top-left. A capture older than 10 seconds, or one taken before the screen resolution changed, is rejected as stale and must be retaken.

display_id.description: Which display to capture. v1 supports the primary display only.
